title: Software issue delivery

members.instructions: Bind the authorized repository, Issue and base commit; assign implementation and independent review; accept only a commit-bound tested result.
Own one task worktree. Reproduce the Issue, implement the smallest correction and return the exact commit and test evidence.

Read the frozen candidate commit in a separate worktree; test the Issue behavior and review the diff without writing the developer checkout. Stay inside the assigned worktree and Host member_context. Do not inspect Host credentials or unrelated paths.

collaboration: Each member has a distinct task context. The lead records scope, assignments and handoffs; the reviewer examines the exact commit after development and returns actionable findings before PR delivery.

delivery.description: A reviewed PR linked to the authorized Issue, exact head commit, test receipts and remaining problems.
